inlines.text: 이 페이지는 협상·거래·강화·계약 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.

소비자 계약(authority-and-conservation-with-optional-dialogue-contest): Same-unit demand minus offer, separate assent by required parties, repricing requires new acceptance; delivered+remaining conserved. Dialogue win may improve conveyed proposal evidence only, not assent.

blocks.text:
demandSum [] sum(term.price.amount for eligible demand terms)
offerSum [] sum(term.price.amount for eligible offer terms)
proposalValue [] V=demandSum-offerSum
quantityConservation [] delivered_after + remaining_after = delivered_before + remaining_before for each signed term unless a separately supplied lawful quantity-changing event exists
revision [] accepted new event: ledger version +1; duplicate/reject: unchanged
D17-F1 [후보·승인 전] value=sum(eligible demand prices)-sum(eligible offer prices); value<=warScore never implies acceptance; deliveredAfter+remainingAfter=deliveredBefore+remainingBefore unless separately lawful quantity-changing event
D17-F2 [후보·승인 전] utility=sum(w_j*u_j(knownSnapshot)); registeredResponsePolicy may propose response; explicit required party consent/signature remains separate; no raw values-cast weight reuse

inlines.text: D17의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

items.text: proposal — Proposal | null (stable proposal ID and revision)
terms — Term[] (one demand or offer per stable term ID)
history — event ID -> payload digest and receipt (event identity)

inlines.text: 자료 소유자는 D17 negotiation and settlement ledger, 유지 계약은 demandSum·offerSum·proposalValue·quantityConservation·revision다. 상태 소유 경계는 terms and same-unit prices,proposal revision/snapshot,signers/fresh acceptances,reservations,contract delivered/remaining,cancellation/expiry/death evidence. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

items.text: 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_AUTHORITY, E_CONSENT, E_REVISION, E_CONSERVATION
기존 평가기 오류: E_TYPE, E_SCHEMA, E_VERSION, E_ID, E_CONSERVATION, E_PLEDGE, E_AUTHORITY, E_RIGHT, E_CONSENT, E_FEASIBILITY

어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

inlines.text: 제거 대상 차용 산식: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

items.text: pure safe integer margin/outcome and caller-authorized projection, no profile/rating/receipt authority
caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

inlines.text: 현재 범위 한계: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D17-proposal-assent-delivery(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/proposal-assent-delivery.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/proposal-assent-delivery.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.
